mainEntity.name: Is there a free meeting notes template?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all 5 in this guide are free to copy. Microsoft and Notion both publish free ones too, though read the fine print: Notion's meetings category mixes free templates with paid ones, so the Brainstorm and Standup Meeting Notes pages are free while others in the same list are not.

mainEntity.name: What is the best format for meeting notes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Details and attendees first, then key points, decisions, and action items with owners and due dates. One choice people get wrong: taking the notes on a laptop. Cornell's Learning Strategies Center points to research finding that handwriting beats typing for recall, so consider writing and typing up the 5 sections afterwards.

mainEntity.name: How do I make a meeting notes template in Google Docs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Type "@" in a Doc and choose the meeting notes building block, or paste a template from above. The block fills in 3 things from the Calendar event: title, date and guest list. Google also lets you save your own wording as a custom building block, so your 5 headings are 2 keystrokes away.

mainEntity.name: Does Notion have a free meeting notes template?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Notion's meetings category lists free pages such as Brainstorm Meeting Notes and Standup Meeting Notes, and any of the 5 templates here pastes in. Worth doing once: turn the page into a database template, because a database of notes can be filtered by project, person or date later.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between meeting notes and minutes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notes are informal records for your team. Minutes are the official record of attendance, decisions and votes, approved at the next meeting, and a meeting minutes sample shows the difference. California HOA boards must go further: the minutes, or a summary, have to be available to members within 30 days of the meeting.

mainEntity.name: How soon should meeting notes be shared?

acceptedAnswer.text: Share them the same day, ideally within 1 hour, while everyone still remembers the context.
